description: Nestled in one of Tarzana’s most desirable neighborhoods, this beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence offers 1,891 sq ft of thoughtfully updated living space designed for both comfort and style. Surrounded by a private backyard that provides the perfect blend of charm and tranquility, the home features a sparkling pool and spa, creating an ideal setting for entertaining or relaxing year-round. Inside, the newly renovated interior showcases quality craftsmanship throughout, including quartz kitchen countertops, custom solid oak cabinetry, updated appliances, recessed lighting, and upgraded light fixtures across the living room, kitchen, bedrooms, and family room. Major system upgrades completed in May 2026 include updated electrical and plumbing, offering peace of mind and modern functionality. The property also features a large detached two-car garage and a flowing floor plan filled with warmth, natural light, and timeless appeal. Located on a beautiful street in the heart of Tarzana, this turnkey home presents a rare opportunity to enjoy refined California living in a serene residential setting.
